title: Rabbi Avin the Carpenter
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Shabbat 23b relates that Rav Huna used to pass repeatedly by Rabbi Avin the carpenter’s doorway. Seeing that the household regularly lit many lamps (in honor of Shabbat), he said: “Two great men will emerge from here.” Rav Idi and Rav Chiyya emerged from that household; see their entries. As for Seder HaDorot’s citation of Midrash Shmuel, beginning of chapter 7, as “Rabbi Bin bar Nagri,” it should read Rabbi Aivu bar Nagri there, as explained in his entry.

notes.text: The proposed correction from Bin bar Nagri to Aivu bar Nagri is Hyman’s. The lamp story concerns the household from which Rav Idi and Rav Chiyya emerged.
